# Vendor marks

Third-party brand marks shown in the top-level README as works-with
attribution. Each is the exact artwork published by its owner; none are
redrawn. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

- `claude-mark.svg`: the Claude sunburst, from Anthropic's published asset.
- `openai-mark.svg`: the OpenAI symbol (2025 mark), from OpenAI's published
  asset; `openai-mark-dark.svg` is the same geometry with the white fill the
  brand uses on dark backgrounds.
- `gemini-mark.svg`: the Gemini spark with its published gradient, from
  Google's hosted asset.
